questions.question: Who was the founder of the Roman Empire?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Augustus was the founder of the Roman Empire.
Incorrect. Julius Caesar was Octavian's great-uncle, but he was not the founder of the Roman Empire.
Incorrect. Mark Antony was a rival of Octavian, not the founder of the Roman Empire.
Incorrect. Tiberius succeeded Augustus as emperor, but he was not the founder.

questions.question: What was Augustus's birth name?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says Augustus was born Gaius Octavius.
Incorrect. Octavianus is the Latin form of Octavian, which he later assumed, but his birth name was Gaius Octavius.
Incorrect. Julius Caesar was his great-uncle, not his birth name.
Incorrect. Marcus Agrippa was his naval commander, not his birth name.

questions.question: In what year did Augustus become the first Roman emperor?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states he was the first Roman emperor from 27 BC until his death in AD 14.
Incorrect. 44 BC was the year of Caesar's assassination, not when Augustus became emperor.
Incorrect. 31 BC was the year of the Battle of Actium, not when he became emperor.
Incorrect. AD 14 was the year of his death, not when he became emperor.

questions.question: Who named Octavian as his primary heir in his will?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says Octavian's great-uncle, the dictator Julius Caesar, named him as his primary heir.
Incorrect. Mark Antony was a rival, not the one who named Octavian as heir.
Incorrect. Marcus Lepidus was a member of the triumvirate, not the one who named Octavian as heir.
Incorrect. Tiberius was Octavian's successor, not the one who named him as heir.

questions.question: After Caesar's assassination, Octavian inherited his estate and assumed what name?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says Octavian inherited his estate and assumed his name, becoming known as Octavian.
Incorrect. Augustus was a title he received later, not the name he assumed immediately after Caesar's death.
Incorrect. Princeps was a title meaning 'first citizen', not the name he assumed after Caesar's death.
Incorrect. Pater Patriae was a title meaning 'father of the country', not the name he assumed after Caesar's death.

questions.question: Who formed a triumvirate regime with Octavian and Marcus Lepidus?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Octavian, Mark Antony, and Marcus Lepidus formed a triumvirate regime.
Incorrect. Julius Caesar was dead by then, so he could not have formed the triumvirate.
Incorrect. Marcus Agrippa was Octavian's naval commander, not a member of the triumvirate.
Incorrect. Tiberius was not part of the triumvirate; he was a later successor.

questions.question: At which battle did Marcus Agrippa defeat Antony in 31 BC?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says Marcus Agrippa defeated Antony at the Battle of Actium in 31 BC.
Incorrect. The Battle of Philippi was in 42 BC, not where Agrippa defeated Antony.
Incorrect. The Battle of the Teutoburg Forest was a later setback in Germania, not related to Agrippa's victory.
Incorrect. The Battle of Mutina was during a state emergency, not where Agrippa defeated Antony.

questions.question: What happened to Antony and Cleopatra during Octavian's invasion of Egypt?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Antony and Cleopatra killed themselves during Octavian's invasion of Egypt.
Incorrect. They did not be captured; they took their own lives.
Incorrect. They did not escape to Greece; they died in Egypt.
Incorrect. They did not surrender; they committed suicide.

questions.question: What did the Senate grant Augustus to avoid the appearance of monarchy or dictatorship?
options: The powers of the tribunate and censorship
The title of consul for life
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says the Senate granted him the powers of the tribunate and censorship, along with titles like princeps and augustus.
Incorrect. Augustus refused to stand for reelection to the consulship and avoided the appearance of dictatorship.
Incorrect. There is no mention of the title of king; he avoided monarchy.
Incorrect. He refused to stand for reelection to the consulship, so he did not become consul for life.

questions.question: Who succeeded Augustus as emperor?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says he was succeeded as emperor by his stepson and adoptive son Tiberius.
Incorrect. Mark Antony died before Augustus, so he could not succeed him.
Incorrect. Marcus Lepidus was exiled and died before Augustus, so he could not succeed him.
Incorrect. Marcus Agrippa was a commander, not the successor; Tiberius succeeded Augustus.
